jobs.description: SamenvattingAre you looking for a dynamic role as a Warehouse Employee in Ridderkerk? At Van Gelder Fruit & Vegetables, you’ll work in a modern family business and contribute daily to fresh, healthy products. Discover why this Warehouse Employee position in Ridderkerk is a great step for your career. Good work!Over de functieAs a Warehouse Employee at Van Gelder Fruit & Vegetables in Ridderkerk, you’ll be active every day in a modern, fresh environment. You’ll process fresh fruit and vegetables with your team, making sure everything is perfectly packaged and ready for shipping. You’ll lift and stack boxes onto pallets, use sharp tools like knives and cutting machines safely, and pack ready-made salads according to clear instructions. Keeping your workspace clean, both in the warehouse and the production area, is also part of your job. You’ll work in a chilled environment, around 7°C, so it’s important that you can handle that. Working days are arranged in consultation, and you can be scheduled on weekdays and weekends. Shifts are flexible, usually between 6:00 and 23:00. Over het bedrijfAt Van Gelder Fruit & Vegetables, you’ll join a family business that has been a leader in fresh potatoes, vegetables, and fruit for more than 65 years. From their modern location in Ridderkerk, over 350 colleagues deliver the best products daily to the Dutch food service industry. Van Gelder combines Dutch down-to-earth values with innovation and sustainability, offering you an inspiring workplace. You’ll work in a close-knit team where your effort is appreciated and everyone works together to deliver top quality every day.
